effect.en: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.

flavor.en: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.
flavor.ko: 비축된 힘을 꿀꺽해서 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 비축된 만큼 회복한다.
